Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
When Andrew Stuart plays Diversion at tha and he draws a card and it
is another Diversion, does it cancel?

When Andrew Stuart plays Diversion at for/cel does it trigger his
special?

Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:
On Jun 26, 10:44 am, XZealot <xzea...@cox.net> wrote:
> When Andrew Stuart plays Diversion at tha and he draws a card and it
> is another Diversion, does it cancel?
>
> When Andrew Stuart plays Diversion at for/cel does it trigger his
> special?

When played at for/cel, it is not a card that requires tha.  When it's
in your library, it is a card that requires tha, as well as a card
that requires for, and a card that requires cel.  So.... yes, no.

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
XZealot <xzealot@cox.net> wrote:
> When Andrew Stuart plays Diversion at tha and he draws a card and it
> is another Diversion, does it cancel?

Yes.  

> When Andrew Stuart plays Diversion at for/cel does it trigger his
> special?

No.  For the same reason that an anarch Al-Muntaquim can play Diversion
at fortitude, even though he can't play cards requiring celerity.
